name: tta-server
description: Tanzania Tennis Association Backend Server - Node.js + Express + TypeScript + PostgreSQL

scripts.build: tsc && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.cpSync('src/views', 'dist/views', {recursive:true, force:true}); fs.copyFileSync('src/db/schema.sql', 'dist/db/schema.sql'); fs.copyFileSync('src/db/seed.sql', 'dist/db/seed.sql');"
